files.finding: info:true selects the synchronous stream engine.

The synchronous loop collects output chunks, allocates another on exhaustion, checks exact maxOutputLength, closes the native handle, and concatenates multiple chunks. Constructor allocates the configured chunkSize at line445.

candidate: Set chunkSize to known logical length plus one; keep maxOutputLength equal to the logical length and retain final exact-length check. Avoid fully exhausting the first chunk on valid input.
